create_ctw_generator: create a CTWGenerator instance to generate binary data sequences from Context Tree Weighting models
build_ctw_tree: build a Context Tree Weighting tree hashmap by recursively spawning nodes and sampling theta parameters
sample_ctw_sequences: sample binary sequences from CTW trees with one-hot encoded features and associated categorical probabilities
find_theta_for_sequence: find the matching theta and context length for a given binary sequence in a CTW tree hashmap
generate_ctw_params: generate multiple independent CTW tree parameters for batched sequence sampling
